fills.researcher_notes: Pressure was blank; filled at 10 MPa from two independent sources naming this branch: the MEE ministry-level completion-acceptance letter (regulator class) and the Hunan provincial-government gas plan (planning-document class), different publishers and document classes. NOTE FOR THE RECORD (not staged): the same Hunan document contains ONE internally inconsistent prose passage elsewhere ('设计压力为6.3MPa') describing the Hunan-only 89 km portion of this same branch -- this conflicts with both the document's own parameter table (10 MPa) and its own full-route paragraph (10 MPa), and with the independent MEE source (10 MPa). Treating it as a document-internal error (2 of 3 in-document mentions, plus an independent source, agree on 10 MPa) rather than staging a third, minority value or filing __VALIDITY__ -- flagging here in case another reviewer surfaces the same 6.3 MPa figure. These two documents were read in full for every other column of this row (see the already_sourced Status/Fuel/Start/Capacity/Length/Diameter/FuelSource entries already in the payload, none of which needed re-verification here) and are the same pair used for the Location and FuelSource records below.
